title: Walks in a Finite Unique Games Instance
statement: Let $G$ be a finite Unique Games instance with a nonempty finite set of variables and a nonempty finite set of constraint occurrences. A walk from one variable to another is generated by the following steps: a length-zero walk at any variable; traversal of a constraint from its source to its target or in the reverse direction; and concatenation of two walks whose endpoints match.
hypotheses_covered: The variable set is finite and nonempty
The constraint-occurrence set is finite and nonempty
Each constraint has distinct source and target variables
Each constraint is decorated by a permutation of $ in q$
Every variable is an endpoint of some constraint
